result.title: Dialogue Generation for Conversational Recommendation Using User Search Interactions and Knowledge Graphs
result.comment: 6 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables, The 3rd Workshop on Evaluating and Applying Recommender Systems with Large Language Models (EARL) at The 35th ACM International Conference on Information and Knowledge Management (CIKM 2026)
result.summary: Large-scale conversational recommendation datasets typically require manual dialogue construction or annotation. We propose SearCl, which automatically generates conversational recommendation dialogues grounded in user search and click behaviors. SearCl segments user interactions into query sessions and derives each recommendation target from content selected after a search query. A configurable probabilistic state machine controls the dialogue flow, while two LLM agents acting as the seeker and recommender generate utterances according to turn-level constraints. To support recommendation, the recommender is provided with knowledge graphs constructed from metadata about the content items used in each dialogue, capturing their attributes and relationships. Using SearCl, we generate 3,538 dialogues from content search and click interaction data, covering 1,731 unique target items. Under an LLM-as-a-judge protocol, the resulting dialogues achieve higher quality scores than dialogues from existing benchmarks. These results demonstrate that SearCl enables controllable and knowledge-grounded dataset construction without human annotations.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 SearCl，利用用户搜索与点击行为、概率状态机和 seeker/recommender 两个 LLM 代理自动生成基于知识图谱的对话推荐数据集。
